address: 377 2 Chiang Rai Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50200, Thailand
bio: The décor is simple, with a display of photos and messages on post-it notes from customers gone by. Aunt Aoy spent much of her career cooking in hotel kitchens. Her expertise is realised in the fluffy yet crispy Chef Omelette with stir-fried minced pork, salted egg and pork crackling....
